answer_4.guideline: The human evaluators were given task-specific instructions based on the definitions in Section 3, including criteria for AD ACCEPTABILITY (unacceptable phenomena), AD CONSISTENCY (binary consistency), A3 RECOGNITION (advertising appeals), and AD SIMILARITY (similarity score).
